acceptanceCriteria: Either affected/breakage resolves includeBuild and SPM local/revision dependencies to the dependent repo's units, or both are reported as a named cross-repository frontier with the dependency path.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). beamfall-android uses includeBuild(../beamfall-android-ui) and beamfall-apple pins beamfall-apple-ui by SwiftPM revision; breakage covers Go only, so cross-repo obligations are invisible.
title: affected: cross-repository edges for Gradle includeBuild and SwiftPM revision pins
